title: How is Zeus connected to Luffy?
description: A Versailles painting, the Capitol dome, the line of presidents, the MythBusters and a cast of voice actors link Zeus to Luffy.
fun_fact: In Brumidi's dome, Minerva teaches Benjamin Franklin, Samuel Morse and Robert Fulton, and the 13 maidens around Washington stand for the first 13 states.
research_note: France's rulers after Henry IV are too short a line for a scroll, so the myth crosses to history through Minerva, Zeus's daughter, who is painted in the Capitol dome with George Washington; the voice-actor tail to Luffy stays as before.
hook: How is Zeus connected to Luffy?

image.file: File:René-Antoine Houasse - Story of Minerva - Minerva and the Triumph of Jupiter, 1706.jpg

links.line: In 1706, a painter put Jupiter, the Roman Zeus, beside his daughter Minerva.
In 1865, Brumidi painted Minerva circling George Washington in the Capitol dome.

links.line: From 1789, the presidency passed from Washington all the way to Barack Obama.
In 2010, Obama filmed a MythBusters episode with Adam Savage.

image.file: File:Jamie Hyneman, Grant Imahara, Adam Savage (7613294308).jpg

links.line: In 2012, Savage shared a Comic-Con stage with fellow MythBuster Grant Imahara.
In 2013, Imahara posed with Chris Doohan, son of Star Trek's original Scotty.

image.file: File:Michele Specht, Vic Mignogna, Chuck Huber, Todd Haberkorn & Chris Doohan (18092409509).jpg

links.line: In 2015, Doohan shared a Phoenix Comicon panel with voice actor Todd Haberkorn.
Back in 2011, Haberkorn signed autographs with his Fairy Tail co-star Colleen Clinkenbeard.

pair.file: File:Colleen Clinkenbeard & Luci Chrisitan - One Piece QA - 53140731572.jpg

links.line: And since 2007, Clinkenbeard has voiced One Piece's hero, Luffy.
